meta.description: Analyze single-cell ATAC-seq with Signac/ArchR (R) and SnapATAC2 (Python alternative). Use when processing scATAC fragments, choosing a framework, calling consensus peaks, running TF-IDF/LSI while diagnosing the depth component, scoring chromVAR motif deviations against GC-matched backgrounds, detecting homotypic vs heterotypic doublets, or deciding whether to binarize the count matrix.

inputs.label: Full workflow incl. the FIXED-AND-SEEDED chromVAR block, TF ranking, and doublet detection
inputs.note: Central re-audit target -- this is where the T3 veto fired. Independently re-verified on a 4th, freshly-generated synthetic dataset (seed 20260919, 4 cell types Tcell/Bcell/Monocyte/NK, 170 cells post-QC, 379 peaks, 746 JASPAR motifs) that neither the fixer nor the prior re-auditor ever touched. Ran the exact fixed SKILL.md block (with set.seed(1) immediately before getBackgroundPeaks()) as 4 SEPARATE FRESH R PROCESSES (not 4 calls in one session, a stronger test than the fixer's own verification): all 4 produced md5-identical saved result objects (background peaks, z-score matrix, and differential-motif table all identical() = TRUE) -- 138/619 significant motifs (p_adj<0.05), identical top-10 motif list, every run. As a negative control, ran the SAME block UNSEEDED twice on the SAME object: bg_peaks differed in 81.1% of entries, z-scores differed, significant-motif count swung 149 vs 161, top-10 overlap only 8/10 -- proving this dataset genuinely reproduces the original bug and that the fix (not dataset happenstance) is what closes it. Doublet-detection figures (scDblFinder recall) are carried forward from the prior re-audit, not re-run this round -- unaffected by this fix.
inputs.execution_note: Real execution, this audit's own fresh processes: run/17_chromvar_seeded_run.R invoked as 4 independent `Rscript` calls (seeded) + 2 independent calls (unseeded, negative control), run/18_compare_runs.R for the identical()/md5sum comparison. Doublet-detection numbers (recall 0.417) carried forward from the prior re-audit's run/14_doublets_v2.R, not re-executed this round.

recommendations.title: NucleosomeSignal(), TSSEnrichment(), and StringToGRanges() are deprecated in the installed Signac release
recommendations.problem: All three documented functions still emit 'deprecated, use ATACqc()/etc.' warnings on Signac 1.17.1, re-confirmed on this audit's own 4th dataset run; unaddressed across two fix passes (correctly out of scope both times -- Signac's ATACqc() replacement needs an external fragtk binary, not a drop-in API swap).
recommendations.root_cause: SKILL.md and example scripts predate the 1.17.x deprecation cycle.
recommendations.fix: Note the ATACqc() consolidation in Version Compatibility and update example code before the next Signac release removes these functions outright, the same way RunChromVAR() was removed.
